title: The Poetic Edda
description: The principal collection of Old Norse mythological and heroic poems (Carolyne Larrington's revised 2014 Oxford translation), including the *Völuspá* and *Grímnismál* that describe Yggdrasil, the Norse cosmic tree. The standard primary source for the Yggdrasil tradition the corpus reads comparatively against the Tree of Life.

cited_by.title: The Mill That Grinds the Ages
